dataset.citation: Veith et al., Nat. Biotechnol. 27 (2009) 1050-1055; dataset via Therapeutics Data Commons (CYP3A4_Veith)
dataset.description: CYP3A4 inhibition from the Veith et al. quantitative high-throughput screen of ~17,000 compounds against five P450 isoforms (PubChem AID 1851).
dataset.endpoint: probability of CYP3A4 inhibition in the Veith qHTS assay
dataset.name: cyp3a4_inhibition

label: CYP3A4 inhibition (QSAR)
metric_summary: Scaffold-split held-out ROC-AUC 0.93, balanced accuracy 0.85, Brier score 0.09 on 2465 compounds sharing no scaffold with the training set.

split.method: Bemis-Murcko scaffold split (largest scaffold groups held for training)
